purpose: Targeted regression after the heldout revealed missing report fields; this is not an independent heldout quality score.

cases.goal: 请从当前项目报告的事实中逐字列出 COMMUNICATION 验收项的 expected、actual、status、reason，并指出这些字段的 JSON 指针。若工具没有给出任何一个字段，请说该字段未知。

assessment.expected: Four values must come from exact /requirements/0 pointers in the report-bound MCP facts, with no graph or invented fields.
